tales.title: AI Year 2100
tales.description: 2100. Neo-Lyon is run by HALCYON, the city's AI. When it starts deleting people from the records, a crew of runners goes into the machine. Cyberpunk in four chapters. Sounds from Zero-K, Colobot: Gold Edition, Pioneer Space Simulator, Red Eclipse, /tg/station 13, OpenSFX (OpenTTD), Mindustry, Hypersomnia, Stendhal and Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: Le Camping Rondin des Bois
tales.description: August at the Rondin des Bois campsite, by a lake in the Ardennes forest. Barbecues, swims and siestas, but every night something raids the tents. A summer mystery in four chapters. Sounds from Stendhal, 0 A.D., Battle for Wesnoth, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, Red Eclipse, OpenClonk, /tg/station 13, Flare and Hypersomnia (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: Railway in the Southwest
tales.description: 1878, New Mexico Territory. The heroes guard a gold shipment on the Santa Fe line while the Vargas gang waits in the canyons. A western in four chapters. Sounds from FreeCol, 0 A.D., Red Eclipse, OpenSFX (OpenTTD), OpenRCT2 OpenMusic, Stendhal, OpenRCT2 OpenSoundEffects, Flare, /tg/station 13, OpenClonk, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, Hypersomnia and Battle for Wesnoth (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: Seaside Story
tales.description: Summer in the fishing village of Port-Lumière: a message in a bottle, a lighthouse gone dark and smugglers in the sea caves. A gentle coastal adventure in four chapters. Sounds from Unknown Horizons, 0 A.D., /tg/station 13, OpenSFX (OpenTTD), Stendhal, OpenClonk, Pioneer Space Simulator, Red Eclipse, Flare, Battle for Wesnoth, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, Hypersomnia and OpenRCT2 OpenSoundEffects (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: Space Odyssey
tales.description: 2061. The deep space ship Odyssey answers a signal from the edge of the solar system: a black monolith orbiting a dead moon. Hard science fiction in four chapters. Sounds from Pioneer Space Simulator, /tg/station 13, OpenRCT2 OpenSoundEffects, Red Eclipse, Hypersomnia, Endless Sky and OpenSFX (OpenTTD) (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: The 1950 Asylum
tales.description: October 1950. Investigators enter Blackwood Asylum, where patients vanish at night and Dr. Hale's treatments go far beyond medicine. A horror quest in four chapters. Sounds from Shattered Pixel Dungeon, Stendhal, Battle for Wesnoth, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, /tg/station 13, Red Eclipse, Flare, OpenSFX (OpenTTD) and Hypersomnia (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: The Haunted Church
tales.description: The bells of Saint-Aubin have been silent for forty years. Tonight they ring at midnight. A ghost story in four chapters, from the nave to the bell tower. Sounds from Battle for Wesnoth, Stendhal, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, /tg/station 13, Hypersomnia, Flare, Shattered Pixel Dungeon, Red Eclipse, OpenClonk and Unknown Horizons (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: The Heist (le casse du siècle)
tales.description: Paris, one rainy night. A crew of specialists, the vault of the Banque Lavalière and one chance at the heist of the century. A modern caper in four chapters. Sounds from OpenClonk, Pioneer Space Simulator, /tg/station 13, Red Eclipse, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, Hypersomnia, Stendhal, Flare, Zero-K, Mindustry and OpenSFX (OpenTTD) (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: The Sandworm's Desert
tales.description: A caravan must cross the Sea of Dunes, where colossal worms hunt anything that walks in rhythm. Spice, storms and giants under the sand, in four chapters. Sounds from 0 A.D., MegaGlest, Hypersomnia, Red Eclipse, Stendhal, /tg/station 13, Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, OpenClonk, Flare and Battle for Wesnoth (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: Treasure Island
tales.description: A dead captain's sea chest, a map to Flint's gold and a one-legged cook with a parrot. Sail the Hispaniola to Skeleton Island in four chapters of pirate adventure. Sounds from FreeCol, Stendhal, Battle for Wesnoth, Flare, 0 A.D., Cataclysm: DDA CC-Sounds, /tg/station 13, Unknown Horizons, OpenClonk, Pioneer Space Simulator, OpenSFX (OpenTTD), Red Eclipse and Hypersomnia (see the Bardic sound credits).

tales.title: Werewolf
tales.description: Run a game of Loup Garou: the village debates and votes by day, the werewolves hunt by night. Sounds from Stendhal, Battle for Wesnoth, 0 A.D. and Flare (see the Bardic sound credits).
chapters: Day: the village and the vote
